rows.clause: (R375)(6), (12) and N1, and [T3], amended on the author`s word of 2026-11-21 (Route A on W-ORD-H2-PI1, OPEN_TRAILS :16563), which names itself an amendment to (R375): a fourth reading, (6)(d), joined to (6), made beside the dispatches and the soonest to leave where the ceiling is short; the two addresses it names fetched and no other, the one exception to (12) and N1 on fetches; each text kept in the act`s local bank, untracked; data/b765_pi01_reading.txt the tracked bank; [H3] or [H4] entered by its outcome; [T3]`s clause on W-ORD-H2-PI1 read as the word gives it; the word arriving before the price table is banked, the reading priced in it
rows.words:
BEGIN
THE AUTHOR'S WORD OF 2026-11-21 ON W-ORD-H2-PI1 (OPEN_TRAILS :16563), AN AMENDMENT TO (R375): ROUTE A.
THE FACT. The order names Kreisel 1958 and Davis, Matijasevic and Robinson 1976 as its sources (relay data/b643_pi01_attempts.txt :4, :13). Neither is reached without a subscription: the publisher's page for Kreisel's paper shows its opening extract and offers no purchase; the file the other's publisher gives freely is the volume's front matter and contents, without the chapter.
THE RULING. The reading is taken at open texts, and the two named papers are cited as the origin and marked NOT READ AT SOURCE. The open texts: (i) arXiv 2311.09464, A. Nayebi, On the Riemann Hypothesis and Hilbert's Tenth Problem, its section 2.1; (ii) the message of Martin Davis to the FOM list of 2017-01-11, at cs.nyu.edu/pipermail/fom/2017-January/020249.html.
THE READING, joined to (R375)(6) as a fourth reading, (6)(d), made beside the dispatches and the soonest to leave where the ceiling is short. The seat fetches these two addresses and no other; this is the one exception to (R375)(12) and (N1) on fetches. Each text is kept in the act's local bank, untracked. The tracked bank, data/b765_pi01_reading.txt, holds for each its address, its size, its sha256 and the passages read, each by its place and in the seat's own words, with a quotation of fewer than fifteen words a source where one is needed. Read: in (i), the statement that the Riemann Hypothesis is equivalent to a statement of the form "for all n, P(n)" with P decidable, and the property P it derives from the paper of 1976; in (ii), the inequality its author states.
THE OUTCOMES. STANDS: both texts are reached and the form each gives is the same statement; the paragraph the order names is drafted in the bank as the order's entry words it (OPEN_TRAILS :13531), written into no paper, and it enters the census at the census's next edition; [H3] is entered. DIFFERS: both are reached and their forms differ; both are printed, no paragraph is drafted, and [H4] is entered. NOT REACHED: an address is refused; the attempts are banked in the form of data/b643_pi01_attempts.txt, the order stands, and [H4] is entered with that reason.
WHERE THIS WORD ARRIVES. Before the price table is banked: the reading is priced in it. After the table and before the lock: its price is printed with the amendment's row. After the lock: nothing of it is entered at this act, and the next ruling places it.
---- [H3] for OPEN_TRAILS, one line
`W-ORD-H2-PI1` READ at b765 by the author's word of 2026-11-21, Route A: the Pi-0-1 form of the Riemann Hypothesis read at the open texts named in that word (relay data/b765_pi01_reading.txt), <the form, in one clause>; Kreisel 1958 and Davis, Matijasevic and Robinson 1976 cited as its origin, NOT READ AT SOURCE; the census's paragraph drafted in the bank and entered at the census's next edition.
---- end [H3]
---- [H4] for OPEN_TRAILS, one line
`W-ORD-H2-PI1` CARRIED at b765 by the author's word of 2026-11-21, Route A: <the forms of the texts differ | an address was not reached>, as relay data/b765_pi01_reading.txt prints; no paragraph drafted.
---- end [H4]
In [T3] of (R375), the clause on W-ORD-H2-PI1 reads: "`W-ORD-H2-PI1` (:16563), the word given and Route A chosen on 2026-11-21, the reading made at this act".
END
